751240101.text: *sigh* It ran off again. Agh, there's only one left inside the swim ring... What do we do now...

751240102.text: How long is this going to take...

751240103.text: Huh, looks like someone's taking pictures... of the Flowcurrent Birds here?

751240106.text: Right? They're so cute, bobbing about as they walk. And when they puff up into a ball and float on the water... Ah, that just makes Paimon feel happy.

751240109.text: That's the spirit, my lovely young lady with the beautifully shiny silver hair! Truly, the one who created these Flowcurrent Birds deserves all the praise this world can offer...

751240110.text: So great is... Ah, wait, I haven't introduced myself yet. I'm a Flowcurrent Bird photography enthusiast. Call me Jonvelle.

751240111.text: #Sure! My name's Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}... Still, why are you sighing sadly over here? Aren't there tons of Flowcurrent Birds around you?

751240112.text: That's... a long story, but allow me to summarize. There are many just like me, and all of us want to take the most interesting photos...

751240113.text: And just a few days ago, I came up with an idea most ingenious... That is, to put all the Flowcurrent Birds within my Kamera frame into swim rings!

751240108.text: Well, they're cute too, but could you really bear to say "Flying Squirrels are cuter" right in front of a swimming Flowcurrent Bird's face?

751240302.text: I can barely believe that my photo-taking quest, which had eluded me no matter how hard I tried, was completed so quickly with your help...

751240303.text: All these Flowcurrent Birds, their bobbing, rolling forms sitting within their swim rings! A sight so moving as to bring one to tears...

751240305.text: Sometimes, we make our life's pursuit out of something that others cannot understand — indeed, even consider absurd.

751240306.text: Nonetheless, I believe that the number of Flowcurrent Bird enthusiasts in the world shall increase, so long as I keep taking these photos!

751240307.text: Paimon one hundred percent believes in this future too!

751240308.text: Ah, thank you both so much for your help! Please, take these as tokens of my gratitude!

751240401.text: I'll hit the shutter the instant that is done, sure as I'm a Flowcurrent Bird photography enthusiast! Well, not that a title like that inspires much confidence...

751240501.text: All that needs doing is for a swim ring to be put over each of the Flowcurrent Birds within the Kamera frame...

751240502.text: I'll hit the shutter the instant that is done, sure as I'm a Flowcurrent Bird photography enthusiast! Well, not that a title like that inspires much confidence...

751240701.text: Looks like some Flowcurrent Birds have drifted off...\nYou'll have to wait for them to return and try again...
